evidence.assessment: Forward evidence collection; improvements are not assumed from software or data changes.

filter_sensitivity_experiment.note: One unit per simulated selection, net of frozen costs; simultaneous kickoff P&L grouped for drawdown. First eligible fixture snapshot freezes all policies and rejections. Different policies may select different markets/cohorts; results are not paired probability tests. Four weeks or 30 selections do not establish profitability. No automatic promotion; validate a chosen policy on later untouched data.

goal_blend_experiment.note: Uncalibrated fixed variants; paired samples; no betting policy, ROI or promotion.

market_led_experiment.note: Paper results at feed odds, not realized returns. Costs are user-configured per stake. Late reference proxy uses only archived quotes 20–60 minutes before kickoff; not actual closing odds. No automatic collection at close or promotion.

settings_observed.selection: one market per fixture; at most ten fixtures
